Learned through years of experience and passed down through generations, this traditional way of fishing is becoming increasingly rare. How long can it survive?

item.title: CGTN (Chinese state media): The Sea We Call Home — Part Three: Dive Deep into the Reef

It is a skill learned through years of practice and passed down through generations. But fish are becoming harder to find, and fewer young people are choosing to learn the traditional method. What happens to a way of life when the next generation moves on?
